is_anopheles.evidence: The model is developed in the context of malaria vector control, and uses Anopheles gambiae data from previously published literature as a demonstration example (page 13-14: 'here Anopheles gambiae data are extracted for pyrethroid (Alpha-cypermethrin) resistance...').

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions kdr and ace-1 mutations conceptually and cites published data for kdr [26] and ace1 [27] to parameterize model fitness values (page 13-14), but conducts no primary genotyping of target resistance markers.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No primary genotype counts or allele frequencies are reported; the paper only uses genotype-specific survival parameters taken from earlier studies (Kolaczinski et al. 2000 [26] and Essandoh et al. 2013 [27]) for model illustration (Table 6, page 14).

african_field_population.evidence: No mosquitoes were collected or tested in this study; it is a population genetics simulation and mathematical modelling paper.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a theoretical modelling and simulation paper describing a model of insecticide resistance evolution; it re-uses previously published data to demonstrate parameter estimation (page 1, page 13-14).

sub_country_location.evidence: Not applicable; theoretical modelling paper with no field study sites.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; study is a theoretical model.

assessment.summary: This article presents a population genetics simulation model implemented in R to investigate the evolution of insecticide resistance under single use, sequential use, and mixture strategies for vector control. It is purely a theoretical and simulation study with no primary mosquito collections or empirical genotyping data.
exclusion_reasons: Pure modelling study without primary empirical data (is_primary_study = false)
No primary field collection of African Anopheles mosquitoes (african_field_population = false)
No primary genotyping of target resistance markers (reports_target_markers = false)
No extractable primary genotype counts or frequencies (reports_extractable_genotype_data = false)
